description: This file defines an Android activity named MediaProjectionDemo that demonstrates how to capture and share the device screen using MediaProjection API, including UI controls for resolution selection and toggling screen sharing.

classes.name: MediaProjectionDemo
classes.description: Main Android activity class that manages screen capture using MediaProjection API, user interface, and screen sharing lifecycle.

classes.name: Resolution
classes.description: Helper class representing screen resolution dimensions (width and height).

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and prepares screen resolution options.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Stops screen sharing when activity is stopped.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases MediaProjection resources upon activity destruction.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result of screen capture permission request and initializes MediaProjection.

methods.name: onToggleScreenShare
methods.description: Handles toggle button clicks to start or stop screen sharing.

methods.name: shareScreen
methods.description: Starts the screen sharing process, requesting permission if necessary.

methods.name: stopScreenSharing
methods.description: Stops ongoing screen sharing and releases resources.

methods.name: createVirtualDisplay
methods.description: Creates a virtual display for screen capture.

methods.name: resizeVirtualDisplay
methods.description: Resizes the virtual display when resolution or orientation changes.

methods.name: ResolutionSelector (Inner Class)
methods.description: Handles resolution selection from the spinner UI component.

methods.name: MediaProjectionCallback (Inner Class)
methods.description: Callback invoked when media projection is stopped externally.

methods.name: SurfaceCallbacks (Inner Class)
methods.description: Manages surface lifecycle events related to the media projection surface.
